newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Astra to join in cellular phone bid.
newsitem.headline: Astra to join in cellular phone bid.

text.p: Indonesian automobile maker PT Astra International said on Wednesday its telecommunications subsidiary will participate in the bidding of 11 new cellular licences.
"Yes, we are going to bid in the cellular telecommunications projects," Rini Suwandi, finance director of Astra, told Reuters.

The Ministry of Post, Tourism and Telecommunications on Monday started pre-selection registration for bidders for the Personal Communications Network or Digital Cordless System (DCS)-1800 and Personal Handyphone System.
The government has said 11 new licences would be awarded by the end of this year so operations could start in the first quarter of 1998.
Suwandi said Astra will join with France Telecom in the cellular project bid as they already had a joint-venture to install fixed telephone lines in Sumatra.
The joint venture, called PT Pramindo Ikat Nusantara, won a 15-year build-operate-transfer project from PT Telkom to install 516,000 fixed telephone lines in Sumatra.
"We are still holding an intensive study on the cellular telecommunications projects. Maybe within this month, we will come up with details including ownership and other aspects," Suwandi added.
